checks: ClearAuditDeployer, BountyVault and USDCPaymaster all have code

notes: The vault and paymaster are created inside the ClearAuditDeployer constructor, so neither address is a zero placeholder at wire-up time.
Arc's native USDC is the gas token (18 decimals) and also exposes an ERC-20 interface at 0x3600…0000 with 6 decimals. The vault escrows the 6-decimal interface.
USDCPaymaster targets ERC-4337 EntryPoint v0.7 (PackedUserOperation, canonical address 0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032).

ARBITRATOR is the Arc Studio deploy wallet, which is shared across Arc Studio projects and whose key is not held by this repository; dispute resolution requires that wallet to act. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.
